findings.description: Direct inspection of the current sit and crouch renders shows both shorts thighs remain exposed while the front apron hangs behind or between the legs; the side hems curl upward. The front-panel attachment/deformation does not keep a continuous skirt layer over the raised thighs.

Current rear/right renders retain coarse triangular faceting and sharply bunched side folds; the front hem curls inward and appears disproportionately long. Fold construction and surface continuity remain unacceptable.
The rear adjustment tab blends into the jacket and the buckle has no distinct readable shape in the current back view.
Authored UV mapping is still missing. The mesh topology illustration is not a UV layout.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: Current V24 regeneration includes a 4.30 micrometre topology cleanup after face material assignment; the cleanup removes one sliver triangle and does not alter garment design or grant fit/appearance acceptance. Direct review of the regenerated five views and six poses retains the sit/crouch coverage, fold continuity, and rear-tab readability blockers.

nextAction: REJECT. Discard the V24 stronger-thigh-follow hypothesis; do not add more apron length or forward thigh weight. Replace front-lap attachment/deformation with a continuous overlapping panel that stays above both raised thighs in sit and crouch. Revise fold construction and surface continuity, and give the rear tab and buckle clear geometry/material separation. Author and verify real UVs. Rebuild as a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses; fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified.
